n, d, max_n = map(int, input().split())

INFINITY_VAL = 99999999
min_difference = INFINITY_VAL
best_num = 0
best_den = 1

for i in range(1, max_n + 1):
    approx_num = int(round(n * i / d - 0.0000001))
    diff = abs((n / d) - (approx_num / i))
    if diff < min_difference:
        best_num = approx_num
        best_den = i
        min_difference = diff

print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
